sentence: You should have call me last night.
ruleVi: Should have + V3: đáng lẽ đã nên làm.

sentence: She can't have forget our meeting.
ruleVi: Can't have + V3: chắc chắn đã không xảy ra (forget → forgotten).

sentence: Minh must has left already because his bag is gone.
ruleVi: Sau modal luôn dùng 'have' nguyên mẫu: must have + V3.

sentence: I might of left my keys in the car.
ruleVi: Suy đoán về quá khứ: might have + V3; 'of' chỉ là cách nghe nhầm.

sentence: They could have win the match if they had tried harder.
ruleVi: Could have + V3: đã có thể làm nhưng không làm.

sentence: He can't had seen me because I was in Huế.
ruleVi: Suy luận phủ định về quá khứ: can't have + V3.

sentence: You shouldn't have eat so much at dinner.
ruleVi: Shouldn't have + V3: đáng lẽ không nên làm.

sentence: The road is wet, so it must rain last night.
ruleVi: Suy luận chắc chắn về quá khứ: must have + V3.

sentence: She may missed the bus this morning.
ruleVi: Suy đoán về quá khứ: may have + V3.

sentence: Nam shouldn't said that to his boss.
ruleVi: Phê phán việc đã làm trong quá khứ: shouldn't have + V3.
